theses.thesis: T1: Google Cloud margin expansion persists as revenue scales, making Cloud the main profit driver.
theses.signpost: Google Cloud operating margin above 20% in each 2026 quarter and Cloud growth above 30% in the Q4 2026 report; invalidation below 15% in any 2026 quarter.

theses.thesis: T2: Free cash flow stays under pressure through 2026 as capex rises, so funding rather than earnings limits the stock.
theses.signpost: Trailing twelve-month FCF in the FY2026 10-K below $50bn; FY2026 FCF at or above $73.3bn in the Q4 2026 results per the earlier log. Invalidation if trailing FCF exceeds $60bn with capex growth slowing.

theses.thesis: T3: The current valuation requires growth above Alphabet's own history for a decade.
theses.signpost: FY2026 revenue growth of at least 24%, in line with consensus, reported in the FY2026 10-K; invalidation if FY2026 growth is below 18% or FY2027 consensus revenue is cut by more than 5% during 2026.

theses.thesis: T4: Near-term estimates hold up, but delivery risk is real.
theses.signpost: Quarterly EPS at or above consensus in the Q4 2026 report; invalidation if another 2026 quarter misses by more than 5% or FY2026 EPS consensus falls below $12.00.
